mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a low federal funds rate and a high unemployment rate indicates a policy response to economic weakness, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: The interaction effect is not significant: the negative return signal fails when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% and UNRATE is above 6.0% in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high housing market activity regime (HOUST > 900 thousand units), rising home construction signals strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 900.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO increases by at least 0.5% over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 800 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where HOUST < 800.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between high housing starts (HOUST > 900) and strong industrial production (INDPRO > 102) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST > 900 and INDPRO > 102.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5%), rising consumer prices erode corporate profit margins and prompt central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5%.
